invariants.name: text_editor_does_not_layout_full_tree
invariants.note: Caret-local replace must not default to a full-tree layout. Live dump layouts 0. text_shaped<=1 is not this hotspot: the world has one TEXT node, so that bound stays green under full-tree layout. Missing layout_nodes stays not-evaluable.

notes: Mapped onto a retained TextArea holding document_chars UTF-8 with a 40-line viewport height in an isolated AppContext. Measures caret-local replace_text_area_selection. Does not reshape the 100k document as N entities, and does not measure IME-inside-editor or multi-caret.
